messages:
anya: Quick design check: proposing a compact range slider for min/max GPUs with a tiny sparkline above it. pros: cleans up form, cons: accessibility. thoughts?

kevin: I like compactness if we expose numeric inputs on focus. keyboard users need independent control of each thumb. aria-labels: 'min GPUs' and 'max GPUs'.

maria: add a 40x12 sparkline with a tooltip explaining the metric (utilization %). aria-describedby should tie the slider to that explanation.

anya: copy for burst badge: 'Burst capacity enabled' vs 'Burst allowed' 5 chars max?

kevin: vote 'Burst capacity enabled' 5 clearer. also show live est. cost below slider when dragging: 'Est. change: +$30/mo (+8%)' and put in aria-live polite.

maria: for guardrail notifications, prefer an inline muted chip 'Rerouted to ai-cost-small' that opens a small flyout with last 3 decisions. screen reader users should get an ephemeral toast 'Guardrail triggered. View routing history'.

designbot: A11y check: range thumbs need distinct aria-labels; contrast on chips fails AA at current color (3.6:1) 5% darker recommended. provide numeric input fallback. Report: https://ci.redwood/a11y/1919999000

anya: ok will: 1) add numeric inputs, 2) wire aria-live for cost delta, 3) change chip color, 4) implement flyout instead of modal for history. I'll post updated mocks.

kevin: one more: admins can have single-click 'increase max' inline; non-admins get confirmation modal. tag @designbot for accessibility re-check once mocks land. :rocket:
